demographic_order.note: demographic-line position was held constant at '00011011' in every request, so it is not a source of within-collection variation and its causal effect is not identifiable here

collection.separately_elicited: each of the 6 answers was rated in its own API call; no multi-answer vector was ever jointly elicited

cross_validation.assignment: default_rng(SeedSequence([cv_seed, repeat])).permutation then numpy.array_split into folds

data.alignment: within each cell, each answer's draws are independently permuted with default_rng(SeedSequence([panel_seed, cell_index, answer_index])) and read side by side
data.alignment_caveat: the 6 answers were each rated in a separate API call; the aligned vectors assume independence across answer-specific draws and are not 6 ratings from one individual

demographic_order.note: demographic-line position was held constant at '00011011' in every request, so it is not a source of within-collection variation and its causal effect is not identifiable here

discovery.excluded_from: policy training, every cross-validation test fold, hyperparameter selection and the headline estimate
discovery.stratification: balanced by persona cell; the remainder cells are drawn from the seed

groups.discovery_only: every number used to rank, filter and select comes from the reserved discovery sample; no analysis respondent, fold or fitted policy is read
groups.low_end_sign_note: 'low' is the low end of the observed correlation range, not by itself a claim about sign; each candidate's correlation is reported with its sign. Here the observed range is -0.094651 to 0.997580, and 1 of 8 candidates correlate negatively with it. The ordinary slot is the median rather than the maximum because a maximum-correlation group is close to indistinguishable from universal
groups.membership: a deterministic function of the persona bitstring; nothing is imputed or back-filled
groups.not_tuned_to_the_result: the slot counts are fixed by the analysis configuration
groups.rule_intent: four groups from the low end plus one ordinary median group, so the family is not composed entirely of outliers and the multigroup arm is also asked to serve a group that behaves like the population
groups.selection: selected on the discovery sample only, then frozen
groups.selection_frozen: run once on the discovery sample before any policy fit; not repeated inside a CV repeat and never recomputed on analysis respondents
groups.tie_break: low slots: correlation ascending; median slot: the lower median of the remaining eligible candidates in ascending correlation; high slots (unused here): correlation descending; then discovery support descending, then candidate file order; slots are filled low, then median, then high, and a candidate can fill only one slot
groups.uncertainty_note: the headline interval is conditional on this family and carries no uncertainty from having selected it
groups.universal: always included and never counted as a selected subgroup

panel.independence_assumption: the answers were evaluated in separate API calls, so the aligned vectors assume independence across answer-specific rating draws within a cell
panel.not_individuals: a pseudo-respondent is not 6 ratings from one simulated individual, and a persona bitstring identifies a demographic cell rather than a person
